cases.fullName: ML1 product path keeps memory mode off storage-free and behavior-neutral
cases.invariant: The default and explicit off paths do not create or open the memory database and do not change the ordinary Agent result.

cases.fullName: ML1 deterministic episode builder matches the frozen verified run golden
cases.invariant: One exact completed Agent run produces one byte-stable source-bound episode and unsafe or incomplete runs produce none.

cases.fullName: ML1 packed-style CLI reads the same logical episode after a full process restart
cases.invariant: A second Node process lists and shows the exact canonical record and record hash written by the first process.

cases.fullName: ML1 SQLite episode store applies exact scope predicates to every get and list
cases.invariant: A different principal, repository id, or canonical root identity observes zero records and cannot reuse a foreign cursor.

cases.fullName: ML1 SQLite episode store makes duplicate ingest idempotent and conflicting bytes corrupt
cases.invariant: Ten identical ingests leave one row while the same record id with a different hash is rejected without overwrite.

cases.fullName: ML1 show marks missing or tampered exact session evidence stale
cases.invariant: Missing lines or changed raw bytes never produce an available source view or a source excerpt.
